Drawn c.1892–93: 1702 here is the pre-Glessner-Lee-townhouse house (pa-1702-43, demolished before 1904) and 1726 is the early house later replaced, so for 1904 this is evidence of the earlier generation at those two lots; 1720, 1736, 1800–1812 are the buildings standing in 1904. Diagrammatic — façades are simplified and proportions not reliable for measurement; treat as a numbered sequence/massing guide.
